name: Tiles of the Simpsons 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Tiles of the Simpsons is a fun and addictive puzzle Mahjong-inspired tile-matching game that brings your favorite characters from The Simpsons to life! The game aims to clear the board by matching identical tiles, each featuring iconic characters, items, and scenes from the beloved show.
